title: Ah! The One-Winged Angel Descends!
overview: A dark force causes several angels in Heaven to collapse. Lind, the legendary Valkyrie, arrives on Earth and declares a state of emergency: The Angel Eater has escaped!

title: Ah! Two of Us, Together in Joy!
overview: Lind, Keiichi, and the Goddesses continue their struggle against Hild and the Angel Eater.
